title: fleet-differences-query
description: Which cabinets the fleet's differences from their baselines are counted over: all, one client or one site, optionally only cabinets of one role and only differences from one level of baseline.

role.description: Only cabinets of this role (finding F7).

from.description: Only differences from what this level of baseline expects, such as the role's: "which cabinets differ from their role" (finding F7).
